Communications. software. developmental disabilities. communications. activities. movie theater helps students. social skills software Attainment Community Success Software Attainment's Community Success Software that focuses on 24 important activities like riding the bus, grocery shopping and going to the movie theater helps students with developmental disabilities in preparing for community outings and eventual independence. Information in the software is made accessible through video modeling, photo based directions, talking stories and bright illustrations of social behaviors. Version 3.0.7 software featuring photos that illustrate the activities step by step has videos that take place in actual locations. Software helps to keep track of student scores, assign specific activities and print out step, social skill and story pages from PDFs. It has professional narration of short stories with highlighted text while emphasizing safety, activity tips and relevant vocabulary. Software being touch screen and switch compatible comes as a Win/Mac CD.
